pull.title: routing: add ordered multi-stop jobs and tracking
pull.body:
## Summary
- support up to 10 ordered intermediate stops on route quotes and jobs
- send Google Routes `intermediates` and make the deterministic provider sum every leg
- keep car / bicycle / walking comparisons on the same A → stops → B route
- snapshot ordered stop details into the job while keeping exact addresses out of public job responses
- expose exact ordered stops only through the participant-protected job route endpoint
- extend live tracking with `TO_STOP` and `nextStopSequence` so ETA advances A → stop 1 → stop 2 → … → B
- add numbered stop autocomplete/markers, add/remove stop controls, and multi-stop summaries in the React UI
- add Flyway V18 for route/job stops and tracking cursor state
- add backend coverage plus an end-to-end multi-stop runtime smoke

## Privacy and cost
Exact stop coordinates/labels follow the same participant-only privacy boundary as exact A/B. The UI limits intermediate stops to 10 so normal requests remain below Google Routes' higher waypoint tier threshold discussed in product design.

## Compatibility
The existing `/jobs/{id}/tracking/pickup` endpoint remains backward-compatible and now advances the current checkpoint when multi-stop tracking is active. Jobs without stops keep the existing A → B behavior.

## Merge gate
Do not merge unless Maven/API verify, frontend audit/lint/build, container/Flyway/runtime smoke, multi-stop smoke and payments-ledger smoke are all green.
